x: The community development programme was started in India, just after independence (in October, 1952). It was a multi-project programme with the aim of an overall development of rural people. The Central Government established District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) in 1980 as a body of professionals to plan, monitor and evaluate rural development programmes at district level.
